Which statement is correct :-
(a) In a semiconductor, the concentration of electrons is 8 × 1014/cm3 and that of the holes is 5 × 1012 /cm3. The semiconductor is N-type
(b) Silicon is a semiconductor. If a small amount of Arsenic is added to it, then its electrical conductivity decreases
(c) To obtain a P-type germanium semiconductor, it must be doped with Arsenic
(d) Energy bands in solids are a consequence of Pauli's exclusion principle
questions.explanation:
Statement (a) : "In a semiconductor, the concentration of electrons is 8 × 1014/cm3 and that of the holes is 5 × 1012 /cm3. The semiconductor is n-type." 
This is a correct statement. Because,
Concentration of electrons (ne) > Concentration of holes (nh)
So, the semi-conductor is of n-type.

Statement (b) : "Silicon (Si) is a semiconductor. If a small amount of Arsenic (As) is added to it, then its electrical conductivity decreases." 
This is an incorrect statement. Since, 'As' is an element of Group-15 (like P, Sb, Bi), which has a valency equal to 5. So, when it is mixed as an impurity with pure (intrinsic) semiconductor (like Si, Ge), then it will create more free electrons & form an n-type extrinsic semiconductor. Hence, due to a large increment in the number of charge careers, its electrical conductivity increases. 

Statement (c) : "To obtain a p-type Germanium (Ge) semiconductor, it must be doped with Arsenic (As)." 
This is an incorrect statement. Because, a p-type extrinsic semiconductor is formed, when a pure (intrinsic) semiconductor (like Si, Ge) is doped with trivalent (3-valence) impurity atoms of Group-13 (like B, Al, Ga, In), as they create more "holes", which become majority carriers.
Since, 'As' is an element of Group-15 (like P, Sb, Bi), which has a valency equal to 5. So, when it is mixed as an impurity with pure (intrinsic) semiconductor (like Si, Ge), then it will create more free electrons & form an n-type extrinsic semiconductor.

Statement (d) : "Energy bands in solids are a consequence of Pauli's exclusion principle." 
This is a correct statement. Because, when many atoms come close in a solid, their electron energy levels overlap. Because of Pauli’s exclusion principle, no two electrons can share the same quantum state, so the levels split into many closely spaced levels. These closely spaced levels form energy bands.
Option (4) says that Statements (a) & (d) are correct.
Final Answer : Option (4)

Ecosystems need a constant supply of energy to synthesise the molecules they require to :
options: counteract the universal tendency toward increasing disorderliness.
Control the worst impacts of predation.
questions.explanation:
NCERT-XII, Pg. # 245
The correct answer is 3. counteract the universal tendency toward increasing disorderliness.
Here's why:
• Ecosystems and Energy Flow: Ecosystems rely on a constant influx of energy, primarily from the sun, to maintain their structure and function. This energy is used to drive life processes, including the synthesis of complex organic molecules.
• Counteracting Disorder (Entropy): The universe tends towards increasing disorder or entropy (as stated by the second law of thermodynamics). Ecosystems, however, are highly organized systems. They use energy to create and maintain this order - building complex molecules, growing, reproducing, etc. Without a continuous energy input, ecosystems would degrade and lose their organization.
